**Products:**[Integral®](https://www.certara.com/integral-data-repository/)


## Summary


Certara Integral® is the single source of truth for PK/PD data – a purpose-built repository where study data, models, and reports live in one secure, searchable location. But extracting value from that content still means browsing folders, filtering, downloading files, and re-opening them elsewhere to find what you need. Much of it lives in unstructured documents, and metadata isn’t always complete. Meanwhile, PK/PD teams are increasingly looking to AI agents to accelerate their work.


Integral 7.1 introduces a new way for your AI agents to securely search, browse, and retrieve PK/PD content, while your scientists stay firmly in control of interpretation and decisions. Under the hood, this runs on the Integral Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, a new endpoint built for exactly this purpose. Integral 7.1 also delivers upgrades across Integral Search, new public Search APIs, an enhanced History tab, plug-in modernization, and locked-folder search.


## Register now


## What we'll cover


- Model Context Protocol (MCP): connecting AI agents to Integral’s folder structure, versioned files, and domain metadata


- MVP toolset: listing folders, retrieving files and latest revisions, searching by name, content, and metadata, and discovering distinct property values
- Example use cases: molecule research, cross-study comparison, metadata tagging, adverse event discovery, and portfolio insights
- Governance and guardrails: system-level access, admin enablement, and why write actions are limited in the first release
- Attendees will see the Integral roadmap and can request access to the MCP pilot


- Also new in Integral 7.1


- Integral Search UI changes and additional file types for search
- Public APIs for Search
- History Tab Changes for Files & Folders
- Integral Plug-ins shift to Public API
- Filter for a folder by lock date


## This webinar is ideal for:


Clinical Pharmacologists, DMPK scientists, Pharmacometricians
